puntos.texto: Owned by a trust and a non-profit

turnos.t: Why would a clothing brand tell people not to buy its jacket?
That's Patagonia. On Black Friday 2011, it ran a full-page New York Times ad saying 'Don't Buy This Jacket' unless you need it. Strange marketing, or smart corporate social responsibility?

No. Since 1985 it has given one percent of its sales to environmental causes. In 2022, its ownership moved to a trust and a non-profit, to lock in its mission. And loyal customers pay premium prices for a brand they trust.
